neutral_component_scope: Start with conn-named source and matching test, with client/server/util-named files as unconfirmed immediate caller/helper leads. No protocol behavior is inferred.

scope_limits.closure: Later confirm relevant declarations and immediate caller/helper windows; network, protocol, concurrency and dependency claims require evidence beyond filenames.

goal: Later bounded source-grounded verification/specification assessment of this filename-defined Go-library slice; actionable handoff or no-new-work without predetermined properties.
adoption: Read-only planning only; no target production changes or execution without separate actual owner grants and applicable isolation.

license_locators: LICENSE copyright paragraph, source/binary redistribution conditions and disclaimer
provenance.license_interpretation: Primary API BSD-2-Clause identification agrees with inspected root license text.

uncertainties: Upstream description contains testing/adoption assertions; none were independently established.
Semantic version, supported Go range, dependencies, concurrency, protocol conformance and deployment applicability unexamined.
doc.go and tests are uninspected leads, not requirements or reproduced evidence.
Catalog membership and assessment outcome unexamined.
identity_basis: Pinned Git commit/tree plus independently clean working tree and tracked object inventory; not a SHA-256 digest of every working-tree file
